identification: Haig's Dimple 'Superior de luxe Scotch Whisky' ceramic souvenir decanter for the 1987 America's Cup defence, 'Fremantle Western Australia 1987', white glazed porcelain with gilt laurel, two crossed sails and the flags of seven challenger/defender nations (Australia, Italy, UK, USA, Canada, New Zealand, France); Dimple arms on the reverse. In its original clear plastic 'Souvenir Decanter' presentation case with navy/gold bands and Dimple swing tag. Part of John Haig & Co's 1980s ceramic souvenir decanter series (others: Mexico 1986 World Cup Finalists, 1986 Commonwealth Games, RAN 75th Anniversary 1986, Hawaii, Fiji). Ceramic, not glass. Gold capsule over the cork looks intact, so probably sealed and full, but fill cannot be seen through ceramic. Likely 75cl, 40-43%.

viewing_check: Check the capsule and cork are intact and unbroken, gently shake or weigh it to confirm it is full (a full 75cl ceramic is heavy, about 1.5 kg or more), and look for a neck or back label giving volume and strength. Check for chips or crazing on the ceramic and cracks in the plastic case.
